children: Using the Purchase Order Line Insight Screen
You can use the Purchase Order Insight Screen to search and manage purchase order lines in your warehouse.

Using the Purchase Order Insight Screen
The following is discussed in this topic:
You can use the Purchase Order Line Insight Screen to search for and view purchase order line records in your warehouse.
Open the Purchase Order Line Insight Screen.
Use the Basic Criteria Fields (located on the Filter Pane) to indicate the values for your primary search.
Press the Search Button. The system will display  the resulting records in the List Pane.
If you select one of the result records from the List Pane, then the system will display its information in the Detail Pane.
The Purchase Order Line Insight Screen's List Pane displays the results from a query performed in the Filter Pane.
Click on the hyperlink on the Purchase Order to open the corresponding purchase order screen.
Click on the hyperlink on the Purchase Order Line Number to open the corresponding purchase order line screen.
For more general information about the List Pane, see the topic
The Purchase Order Line Insight Screen's Detail Pane displays the specific field values associated with a selected record in the List Pane.
For more general information about the Detail Pane, see the topic
The following actions are accessible from the List Pane:

The action allows to copy an existing purchase order line. Clicking on the action opens the Purchase Order Line Screen in Copy mode with certain fields copied from the selected purchase order line.For additional information, refer to
Creating a Purchase Order Header/Detail in SCALE

The View action allows you to open the Purchase Order Line Insight screen in the read-only mode and the Edit action allows you to open the Purchase Order Line Insight screen in the edit mode. So the View action only permits viewing the purchase order line , while the Edit action permits editing certain fields on the purchase order line.
This action allows you to delete a purchase order line. Success message appears after a purchase order is deleted. You cannot delete multiple purchase order lines together.

        Searching/Viewing Purchase Order Line Records...
        You can use the Purchase Order Line Insight Screen to search for and view purchase order line records in your warehouse. 
        
            Open the Purchase Order Line Insight Screen.
            Use the Basic Criteria Fields (located on the Filter Pane) to indicate the values for your primary search.
            Press the Search Button. The system will display  the resulting records in the List Pane. 
            If you select one of the result records from the List Pane, then the system will display its information in the Detail Pane.
        
         
        
        
         
         
        About the List Pane...
        
            The Purchase Order Line Insight Screen's List Pane displays the results from a query performed in the Filter Pane.
            Click on the hyperlink on the Purchase Order to open the corresponding purchase order screen. 
            Click on the hyperlink on the Purchase Order Line Number to open the corresponding purchase order line screen. 
            For more general information about the List Pane, see the topic Introduction to Insight Screens.
        
         
        
        
         
         
        About the Detail Pane...
        The Purchase Order Line Insight Screen's Detail Pane displays the specific field values associated with a selected record in the List Pane.
        For more general information about the Detail Pane, see the topic Introduction to Insight Screens.
        
        
         
         
        Screen Actions
        The following actions are accessible from the List Pane:
         
        Copy
        The action allows to copy an existing purchase order line. Clicking on the action opens the Purchase Order Line Screen in Copy mode with certain fields copied from the selected purchase order line.For additional information, refer to Creating a Purchase Order Header/Detail in SCALE. 
         
         
        View/Edit
        The View action allows you to open the Purchase Order Line Insight screen in the read-only mode and the Edit action allows you to open the Purchase Order Line Insight screen in the edit mode. So the View action only permits viewing the purchase order line , while the Edit action permits editing certain fields on the purchase order line. 
         
         
        Delete
        This action allows you to delete a purchase order line. Success message appears after a purchase order is deleted. You cannot delete multiple purchase order lines together.
